projectDescription: Tunnelvision is an iOS app that blocks distracting apps and lets a trusted friend hold the unlock button, so you can only regain screen time by completing your habits first.
keyFeatures: Hard app blocks built on Apple's Screen Time framework
Friend-held unlocks — only a trusted friend can approve extra screen time
Habits as proof — complete daily habits to strengthen unlock requests
Focus schedules — recurring blocks for work, study, and sleep
Streak visibility — friends see your consistency over time
Privacy-first — usage data stays on device, never sold or shown as ads
publicApiSurface: App blocking (Apple Screen Time framework integration)
Unlock request — send to friend with habit proof
Premium subscription — monthly/yearly via in-app purchase
